mapper.select: SELECT id, store_id, event_version, menu_status, deleted_at FROM menus WHERE id = #{menuId} AND store_id = #{storeId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO outbox_events(event_id, aggregate_type, aggregate_id, event_version, topic, kafka_key, payload_json, created_at) VALUES(#{event.eventId}, #{event.aggregateType}, #{event.aggregateId}, #{event.eventVersion}, #{topic}, CONCAT(#{event.aggregateType}, ':', #{event.aggregateId}), #{payload}, UTC_TIMESTAMP(6))
mapper.select: SELECT o.id, o.event_id, o.topic, o.kafka_key, o.payload_json, o.event_version, o.retry_count FROM outbox_events o WHERE (o.status = 'PENDING' AND (o.next_retry_at IS NULL OR o.next_retry_at <= UTC_TIMESTAMP(6)) OR o.status = 'PROCESSING' AND o.claimed_until <= UTC_TIMESTAMP(6)) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM outbox_events older WHERE older.aggregate_type = o.aggregate_type AND older.aggregate_id = o.aggregate_id AND older.event_version < o.event_version AND older.status != 'PUBLISHED') ORDER BY o.id LIMIT #{limit} FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
mapper.update: UPDATE outbox_events SET status = 'PROCESSING', claimed_by = #{worker}, claimed_until = DATE_ADD(UTC_TIMESTAMP(6), INTERVAL 30 SECOND) WHERE id = #{id}

UPDATE outbox_events SET status = 'PUBLISHED', published_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(6), claimed_by = NULL, claimed_until = NULL, last_error = NULL WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'PROCESSING' AND claimed_by = #{worker} AND claimed_until > UTC_TIMESTAMP(6)
